trigger.observation: cold boot remained in the approximately one-minute class after outer decoder transports fell to sixteen
trigger.separation: independent of the VM cross-window relative-branch correctness first-red

diagnosis.mechanism: Every kind-3 or kind-7 publication called c2_stream_gc_checkpoint. The product binding forced gc_collect at all 283 checkpoints, and c2_product_gc_mark_roots then read all 283 canonical values in separate two-byte DMA operations. The minimum root-list traffic alone was therefore 283 times 283, or 80,089 DMA reads.
diagnosis.contract_drift: The approved single-source addendum already specified the contiguous root-value plane as a 568-byte/18-read geometry. The product binding had accidentally retained the rejected scattered-read behavior.

candidate_binding.checkpoint: Validate the canonical root range and publish c2_pending_roots before any later allocation; do not force a collection.
candidate_binding.natural_collection: Read the contiguous root-value plane in bounded 32-byte blocks and mark every value without writeback.
candidate_binding.host_stress: Continue to simulate a collection after every kind-3 and kind-7 publication; 283/283 stress points remain covered.
safety_argument: cons may collect before allocating its result, then performs no allocation before the result is published
the streaming string builder roots its open string across any internal collection and performs no allocation between str_close and publication
the checkpoint publishes the full pending-root span before the next descriptor allocation
the collector remains non-moving and never writes a canonical root back

next_gate: One separately authorized product link must attribute the VM logical-PC correction and the GC operational-binding correction independently, run every structural/capacity gate, and then restart the receipt-less hardware presmoke from a full six-artifact restage.
claim_limit: Host-only operational-binding and transfer-count probe. It proves the exact source of the dominant redundant root traffic and the candidate invariant model; it authorizes no product link, capacity debit, hardware acceptance or promotion claim.
